description: CatBoost on the exp011 deeper-geology feature set. The deeper-geology features (multi-row geology context at +/-5/+/-15, layer index, layer position fraction, layer-conditional GR residuals) hurt LightGBM in exp011 (+0.26 vs exp009) but CatBoost handles categorical and ordered features much better — those same features may help here. Worth testing because exp014's leap suggests CatBoost has more headroom with geology-derived signals.
implementation_notes: Reuse exp011 feature pipeline from src/features.py. Drop the target-encoded geology column (CatBoost handles cats natively).
Pass all geology label columns (aligned + offset) as cat_features.
CatBoost params: task_type='GPU', iterations=10000, learning_rate=0.04, depth=9, l2_leaf_reg=5.0, bagging_temperature=0.5, od_type='Iter', od_wait=250, eval_metric='RMSE'.
5-fold GroupKFold by well_id. Save OOF and test predictions matching CSV row order.
Target: beat exp014 (30.454). If matched or close, the diverse OOF is still useful for stacking.
